phase_A_primary_template.name: T0_ONE_ANCHOR
phase_A_primary_template.task: Classify all 15 pairs by exact source legality and tracked semantic-object delta under insertion of that chord alone.

phase_B_general_census.target: Enumerate dangerous source-annotated 7-role templates containing at least one residual-component role C and at least one X0 role, but only from an explicit source grammar extracted from frozen CSZ/Part-B contracts.
required_annotations: fixed X0 color for every X0 role
exact dynamic color mask A(u), not only source L_P(u)
component-internal representative/base-list information relevant to X0 incidence
dynamic complete/anticomplete relation to each connected residual component
source-forced edge/nonedge/optional status for every role pair
phase_B_general_census.no_fake_completeness: Do not claim an exhaustive all-source-template census from an ad-hoc alphabet. General PASS requires an explicit generator whose completeness follows from the frozen source contracts.

chord_firewall: A chord is not a repair. It is only a repair candidate after a separate exact-equivalence/reconstruction theorem for every tracked semantic object changed by that chord.
color_mask_firewall: Role type alone does not imply semantic change in arbitrary source states: adding B-X0 or C-X0 adjacency can be identity-level neutral if that fixed color was already excluded through another same-color X0 neighbor. General census must compare color masks before/after, not only endpoint classes.

terminals.PASS_FINITE_SEMANTIC_CHORD_GRAMMAR: An explicit complete source-derived generator exhausts the declared template scope and every chord obligation is classified by source legality and exact semantic delta.
terminals.PASS_FORCED_NONNEUTRALITY: Within a precisely declared source-derived template class, every P7-killing legal chord changes at least one tracked semantic object.
terminals.FAIL_WITH_SOURCE_VALID_FREE_REPAIR: A source-valid chord class is found whose insertion leaves all tracked semantic objects exactly unchanged.
terminals.PARTIAL_T0_THEOREM_GENERAL_CENSUS_OPEN: T0 is completely sealed but no completeness theorem yet exists for all source-valid 7-role templates.
